title: 第21章 主厨喷血第22章 龙火爆鳄肉
slug: 我能穿越去修仙你跟我分手
content_zh:
“林总！”
“您可算来了！”
“等您半天了！”
姜瑶的笑声，像是被掐住脖子的鸭子，戛然而止。
她脸上得意的表情瞬间凝固。
“林总？”
姓李的中介经理完全无视了僵在原地的姜瑶。
他热情地握住林渊的手。
“林总，办公室都准备好了。”
“我带您和顾总上去看看？”
林渊看都没看姜瑶一眼。
他只是对身边的顾小北温和地笑了笑。
“走吧。”
他迈步越过彻底石化的姜瑶，那姿态，仿佛只是绕过路边一个碍事的垃圾桶。
“等……等等！”
姜瑶不甘心地快步跟了上去。
她嘴里还在不服气地嘟囔。
“装，我看你能装到什么时候！”
“肯定是租了个最小的办公室来骗人！”
“以为开个公司被人称个总就成有钱人了？”

五楼。
李经理推开一扇双开玻璃门，自豪地介绍道。
“林总，就是这间。”
“一百五十平，全景落地窗。”
“视野和朝向都是这栋楼里最好的。”
林渊和顾小北还有中介刚刚进去。
姜瑶不死心地将脑袋凑到门边，刚要探头往里看。
林渊却倏地侧过身，高大的身影如一堵墙，彻底挡住了门外的视线。
他甚至没有看姜瑶的眼睛，只是语气冰冷得不带一丝感情。
“我的地方，不欢迎苍蝇和垃圾。”
“李经理，关门。”
“好嘞！”
李经理心领神会。
在姜瑶尚未反应过来之时，他猛地将厚重的实木门“砰”地一声关上，顺手反锁。
那一声巨响，仿佛一记无形的耳光，狠狠抽在姜瑶的脸上。
她呆立在原地。
content_en:
"Mr. Lin!"
"You're finally here!"
"I've been waiting for you for a long time!"
Jiang Yao's laughter stopped abruptly, like a duck being pinched by the neck.
The proud expression on her face froze instantly.
"Mr. Lin?"
The agency manager named Li completely ignored Jiang Yao, who was frozen in place.
He held Lin Yuan's hand enthusiastically.
"Mr. Lin, the office is ready."
"Shall I take you and Mr. Gu up to have a look?"
Lin Yuan didn't even look at Jiang Yao.
He just smiled gently at Gu Xiaobei beside him.
"Let's go."
He stepped past the completely petrified Jiang Yao, as if he was just bypassing an obstructive trash can on the side of the road.
"Wait...wait!"
Jiang Yao followed quickly unwillingly.
She was still muttering unconvinced.
"Fake it, let's see how long you can keep it up!"
"I must have rented the smallest office to deceive people!"
"Do you think that if you open a company and are called a boss, you will become a rich man?"
Fifth floor.
Manager Li pushed open a double glass door and introduced proudly.
"Mr. Lin, this is the room."
"One hundred and fifty square meters, panoramic floor-to-ceiling windows."
“The view and orientation are the best in the building.”
Lin Yuan, Gu Xiaobei and the intermediary had just entered.
Jiang Yao reluctantly put her head to the door and was about to peek in.
Lin Yuan suddenly turned sideways, his tall figure like a wall, completely blocking the view outside the door.
He didn't even look into Jiang Yao's eyes, but his tone was cold and emotionless.
"Flies and trash are not welcome in my place."
"Manager Li, close the door."
"Okay!"
Manager Li understood.
Before Jiang Yao could react, he slammed the heavy solid wood door shut and locked it.
That loud noise was like an invisible slap, hitting Jiang Yao's face hard.
She stood frozen in place.
